content.title: Fashion Type Modules | Adult Action, Footwear Proof and Word Relay
content.summary: An adult courier drives a walk, shoe, token and echo campaign before a PACE CLUB lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module. + Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word. + Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system. + Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement. + The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Reveal one original clearly adult courier from a navy silhouette into a cobalt face, lime cap, sand jacket, violet cargo trousers and one white spiral badge beside the exact title "EASY PACE". One heel plant on a violet floor disc triggers a readable shoe macro and the exact word "STEP"; no second person or wardrobe appears. Return to one full-body still with courier, token and recurring disc in front of the exact master mark "PACE CLUB"; hold all typography fully readable and stop every echo.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and at least five appearance anchors precede every graphic module.
Each module introduces no more than one exact short word and follows one visible action or prop proof.
Echoes and stickers remain subordinate to the adult and never become replacement characters.
The final lockup reunites the complete adult, proven prop, recurring shape and one original readable master mark.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult courier drives a walk, shoe, token and echo campaign before a PACE CLUB lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用同一成年风格化角色的蓝色面部、橙帽、奶油帽衫、棋盘短裤与黑包锁定身份；大字、步伐、鞋履、复制残影、杯具和贴纸模块逐项响应动作，最终回到人物与原创主标同框的清晰终卡。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and at least five appearance anchors precede every graphic module.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and at least five appearance anchors precede every graphic module."

invariants.rule: Each module introduces no more than one exact short word and follows one visible action or prop proof.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each module introduces no more than one exact short word and follows one visible action or prop proof."

invariants.rule: At least one full-body grid and one footwear close proof re-verify the same identity.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "At least one full-body grid and one footwear close proof re-verify the same identity."

invariants.rule: Echoes and stickers remain subordinate to the adult and never become replacement characters.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Echoes and stickers remain subordinate to the adult and never become replacement characters."

invariants.rule: The final lockup reunites the complete adult, proven prop, recurring shape and one original readable master mark.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final lockup reunites the complete adult, proven prop, recurring shape and one original readable master mark."
